macros.name: choir
macros.doc: Short macro to add (background) choir text.

macros.name: instruction
macros.doc: Short macro to add instructional text.

macros.name: lsenparen
macros.doc: Short macro to add parentheses around text.

macros.name: mkchoir
macros.doc: The formatting macro used by \choir. You can redefine it in order to change the appearance.

macros.name: mkinstruction
macros.doc: The formatting macro used by \instruction. You can redefine it in order to change the appearance.

macros.name: mklsenparen
macros.doc: The formatting macro used by \lsenparen. You can redefine it in order to change the appearance.

macros.name: mklsenparens
macros.doc: The parentheses setting macro used by \lsenparen. You can redefine it in order to change the parentheses.

envs.name: prechorus
envs.doc: Environment for marking the pre-chorus of a song.
